# Copilot instructions — framer

This file is focused guidance for future Copilot sessions working in this repository. It extracts the commands, high-level architecture, and codebase-specific conventions Copilot should know.

---

## Quick commands (what exists now)

Preferred local package manager in README: pnpm

- Install
  - pnpm install
- Development server
  - pnpm dev # runs `vite dev` (script: dev)
- Build
  - pnpm build # runs `vite build` (script: build)
- Preview (production static preview)
  - pnpm preview # runs `vite preview` (script: preview)
- Start (production server)
  - pnpm start # runs `node .output/server/index.mjs` (script: start) — expects a Nitro build in `.output`
- Type checking
  - pnpm typecheck # runs `tsc -b`
- Formatting
  - pnpm format # runs `prettier --write "src/**/*.{ts,tsx}"`

Notes: the GitHub deployment workflow (.github/workflows/deployment.yaml) uses `npm install` and `npm run build` and deploys with Surge (NODE=14). Locally README recommends pnpm; CI currently uses npm.

### Tests & linting

- No test runner or `test` script is configured in package.json.
- No ESLint/lint script is configured. Only Prettier formatting is provided.
- If tests are added with Vitest, run a single test with:
  - pnpm vitest -t "<test name>"
    (or use the test-runner's `-t`/`--grep` to run a single test name/pattern.)

---

## High-level architecture

- Build system: Vite for dev/build (vite.config.ts). Plugins in use:
  - @tanstack/react-start (file-based route generation)
  - @tailwindcss/vite (Tailwind integration)
  - @vitejs/plugin-react (React)
  - nitro (generates `.output` server and public assets)

- Routing: file-based routes under `src/routes/`. The TanStack plugin generates `src/routeTree.gen.ts` (auto-generated) from files in `src/routes`.
  - Root route: `src/routes/__root.tsx` (shell/head links, ThemeProvider, providers)
  - Page routes: `src/routes/*.tsx` (e.g., `index.tsx`)
  - Router bootstrap: `src/router.tsx`

- Server output: Nitro produces `.output/` with `server/index.mjs` and `public/` assets. `pnpm start` runs that server file.

- UI stack: React 18 + TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, next-themes for theming. Code organized by feature: `src/features/<feature>/` with `components/`, `context/`, and `lib/` subfolders (example: icon-browser feature).

- Project-level type config: `tsconfig.json` (noEmit: true). Use `pnpm typecheck` for full repo type checks.

---

## Key repository conventions (non-obvious)

- File-based routing with TanStack React Start
  - Add route files under `src/routes/` using `createFileRoute` / `createRootRoute` patterns.
  - Do NOT edit `src/routeTree.gen.ts` — it is autogenerated by the Vite plugin and will be overwritten. Treat it as generated artifact (exclude from linter/formatter checks if possible).

- Feature layout
  - Organize features under `src/features/<feature>` and use `components/`, `context/`, and `lib/` directories to separate UI, providers/state, and small helpers.
  - Example: Icon browser: `src/features/icon-browser/components/`, `context/`, and `lib/`.

- Styling
  - Tailwind is wired via `@tailwindcss/vite` and global CSS at `src/index.css`. The root route links the compiled CSS (`import appCss from "../index.css?url"`).
  - Prettier is the configured formatter (`pnpm format`). No ESLint config is present.

- Theming & providers
  - The root shell (`src/routes/__root.tsx`) wraps the app with `ThemeProvider` (next-themes) and feature providers (e.g., IconSelectionProvider). When adding global providers, prefer adding them in the root route shell.

- Build & start expectations
  - The `start` script expects a Nitro build output under `.output/server/index.mjs`. Building via `pnpm build` (Vite + Nitro plugin) must be run before `pnpm start`.

- CI / Deployment
  - Deployment workflow deploys the build to Surge (`framer.surge.sh`) and expects `npm run build` in CI. Secrets: `SURGE_TOKEN` is used in the workflow.

---

## Files & places to check during tasks

- Routes & routing glue: `src/routes/`, `src/routeTree.gen.ts`, `src/router.tsx`
- Feature code: `src/features/*` (components, context, lib)
- Vite & build config: `vite.config.ts`
- Type config: `tsconfig.json`
- Package scripts: `package.json`
- CI/deploy: `.github/workflows/deployment.yaml`

---

## AI assistant / Copilot guidance

- Prefer actions that follow existing repository conventions: file-based routes, feature folder structure, Tailwind utilities, and use of next-themes.
- Respect generated files: do not edit `src/routeTree.gen.ts` or other generated outputs; instead modify source route files in `src/routes/` and let the tooling regenerate.
- For formatting changes, run `pnpm format` (Prettier) and `pnpm typecheck` before proposing build or server changes.
- If adding tests or linting, create explicit npm/pnpm scripts in `package.json` so automation and CI can call them.
